title: Wire Supabase into the app + fix court/profile data layer to live schema
body:
## Summary

`main` is currently a local-only demo (AsyncStorage + 33 sample courts). This PR brings the **Supabase backend foundation** into `main` and **fixes the data layer to match the live database**, so the app loads the real **5,734 courts** and can create real accounts. It integrates the unmerged `replit/backend-auth-appstore-foundation` branch (Stage 1: `lib/supabase.ts`, `AuthContext`, `auth` screen, app config) plus the Stage-2 fixes below, and adds canonical working docs.

### Root causes found (verified against the live DB)

1. **Map fell back to sample data** because `courtService` mapped columns that don't exist. The real `courts` schema is `sport_type` / `location` / `state` / `image_url`, plus `local_player_count` / `is_confirmed` on the `courts_with_stats` view — not `sport` / `city` / `active_count` / `rating` / `status`.
2. **Auth "didn't work"** because `ensureProfile` inserted `{elo, tier, check_ins}` and **omitted the required `username`** — every profile insert failed. Real `profiles` columns are `username` (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, `^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,32}$`) and `elo_rating`.
3. **`.env` in the wrong place** — `.env.example` only existed at the repo root, but Expo loads `.env` from the app dir (`artifacts/mobile`).

Verified via the anon REST key: `courts_with_stats` returns all 5,734 rows anonymously (security-definer view), while base `courts` returns `[]` (RLS = authenticated only). ➡️ **No production RLS change is needed**; reading through the view is the correct public path.

### Stage-2 changes (the fixes)

```diff
// services/courtService.ts — map the REAL schema
- sport: row.sport, city: row.city, activeCount: row.active_count, status: row.status
+ sport: normalizeSport(row.sport_type)
+ neighborhood: deriveNeighborhood(row)           // location/state, else parse address
+ status: row.is_confirmed ? "community" : "confirmed"
+ localCount: row.local_player_count ?? 0, imageUri: row.image_url
+ .eq("is_archived", false).limit(6000)           // was limit 5000, no archive filter

// context/AuthContext.tsx — insert what profiles actually requires
- .insert({ id, display_name, elo: 1200, wins, losses, check_ins, tier: "BRONZE" })
+ .insert({ id, email, display_name, username: generateUsername(...), elo_rating: 1200 })
+ // retry on 23505 unique_violation (username clash); UserProfile type updated
```

- `auth.tsx`: status banner now uses `profile.username` / `profile.elo_rating` (the old `profile.tier` / `profile.elo` don't exist).
- `artifacts/mobile/.env.example`: added, with a note that Expo reads `.env` from the app dir + restart with `-c`.

### Docs (working source of truth)

- `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md` — canonical state: schema reality, RLS behavior, data flow, bugs fixed, env gotchas (incl. **Apple Sign-In can't be tested in Expo Go** — needs a dev build).
- `docs/APP_STORE_READINESS.md` — staged roadmap, launch-blocker checklist, decisions log.
- `docs/BACKEND_STATUS.md` — corrected the Stage-1 schema claims that were inaccurate.

## Decision needed (D2)

Browse-before-login (recommended; the public view already supports it, and Apple reviewers prefer visible content without an account) **vs.** a full login gate. Sign-in would still gate writes (check-in, add court, ELO). See `docs/APP_STORE_READINESS.md`.

## Testing

- `pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run typecheck`: no new errors in changed files. ~211 errors remain that are **pre-existing on `main`** (210 in the un-installed `mockup-sandbox/` Vite package, 1 in `app/(tabs)/elo.tsx`); cleanup is a tracked roadmap item. No CI is configured in this repo.
- Not yet exercised on a device/emulator — recommended next step (email sign-up + map render). Apple Sign-In needs a dev build, not Expo Go.

## Notes / not in scope

- No production DB changes. Secrets stay in the gitignored `artifacts/mobile/.env` (public anon + mapbox keys only).
- Check-in / add-court / ELO are still AsyncStorage-only (Stage 3).
